name: SLS Baha Mar
desc: An Indulgent Wonderland In The Bahamas. Make your entrance in a lobby that's always abuzz. Walk among the flamingos. Lounge in a beachfront cabana. Marvel at turquoise waters. Drink in the views from luxe rooms and suites. Feast in countless restaurant and bars. Dress to impress, dance, play, repeat. Welcome to SLS Baha Mar, a Caribbean resort paradise infused with signature SLS glamor, luxury and indulgence.
